title: 债券对冲失效？：贝莱德给出新答案，能源股成关键
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Reality is right now, as you laid out, there's a lot of pressure on the bond market, due to the supply, due to questions about long-term fiscal sustainability.
segments.zh: 现实情况是，正如你所说，债券市场面临很大压力，原因是供应问题以及对长期财政可持续性的担忧。

segments.en: But it's also a function of strong economy. Now, there are two problems right now.
segments.zh: 但这也是经济强劲的表现。现在有两个问题。

segments.en: The first of which is, I think you highlighted in the introduction, bonds are not working as a hedge.
segments.zh: 第一个问题是，正如你在开场中提到的，债券作为对冲工具已经失效。

segments.en: Great source of carry, definitely giving some ballast to a portfolio, but they're not fulfilling that role that they did for most of the last 20, 25 years, where they help diversify equity risk.
segments.zh: 它们提供了很好的收益来源，确实给**组合带来了一些稳定性，但它们没有发挥过去20到25年中的那种作用，即帮助分散权益风险。

segments.en: The other issue is the relationship between bond returns and equity returns, at least historically, has been nonlinear. And what I mean by that is we've had a very good rally in stocks,
segments.zh: 另一个问题是，债券回报与权益回报之间的关系，至少从历史上看，是非线性的。我的意思是，我们经历了市场的大幅上涨，

segments.en: particularly off of the summer lows, despite the back-up and yields. But that doesn't necessarily go on forever. When you go back, you look at history, there does come a point, and I'd put that
segments.zh: 尤其是从夏季低点以来的反弹，尽管收益率上升。但这不一定能永远持续。回顾历史，总会有一个点，我认为

segments.en: somewhere in calls of 4, 9 to 5% level, where that competition for capital starts to bite.
segments.zh: 这个点大约在4.9%到5%的水平，届时资本竞争开始产生影响。

segments.en: In other words, you start to see that higher yields, rather than being ignored by the stock market, due start to impact returns, were not that far from that level of my opinion.
segments.zh: 换句话说，你会开始看到较高的收益率不再被市场忽视，而是开始影响回报，我认为我们离那个水平不远了。

segments.en: The rest is that when the sell-off becomes somewhat self-limiting, that there is only so much further the bond market can go, because it starts to bite risk, and the money goes back to fixed income. Would you call it a buy then when you get to that level
segments.zh: 另外，当抛售变得有些自我限制时，债券市场的下行空间有限，因为它开始影响风险偏好，资金会回流固定收益。你会称之为买入点吗？当达到那个水平时，

segments.en: closer to 5% on 10s? You know, I'm not sure there's one level that I would say okay, now it's all here to jump back in the water. But certainly yes, you do get to a level where the yield
segments.zh: 接近10年期收益率5%时？你知道，我不确定有一个具体的水平可以说，好了，现在可以重新入场了。但确实，你会达到一个收益率水平，

segments.en: starts to become more attractive. When people start to look at what's available in the bond market
segments.zh: 开始变得更有吸引力。当人们开始关注债券市场的可选项时
